newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-NICK PRICE WITHDRAWS FROM WESTERN WITH INJURY.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-NICK PRICE WITHDRAWS FROM WESTERN WITH INJURY.

text.p: Zimbabwean Nick Price withdrew from the Motorola Western Open before the first round Thursday due to a nagging shoulder injury.
Price, winner of three major championships, pulled a muscle in his right shoulder recently.
The injury has not healed as quickly as he had hoped, and he indicated to a PGA Tour official that he was pulling out as a precautionary measure.
It would be premature to suggest he is in danger of missing the British Open in two weeks, but the possibility cannot be ruled out.
